description: Leave the connected account's reaction on a CarlNotes finding, podcast episode, topic, Open Mic post, or hot take: one of six positive types. A reaction is public wherever its topic is, and each account has one per thing it reacts to. A new save changes the type, and a save with no type removes it. Use it when the user tells Carl to react to this or like this finding.

reaction_type.description: The reaction type, or null to remove it.

target_id.description: The id of the finding, the podcast episode, the topic, the topic post, or the hot take.

target_kind.description: What it is on: a finding, a podcastEpisode, a topic, a post, which is a topic's Open Mic post, or a comment, which is a hot take.

name: save_reaction
title: React
